frame: Module frame: origin at the outline centre; +x along the header row from pin 1 to the last pin (two-row modules: along the rows, pin 1 end at -x); +y from the header toward the module body (two-row modules: from the first-listed row to the second). Millimetres. 'front' is the face away from the carrier board.

features.name: servo lead (250 mm, JR plug)
features.note: the servo mounts in the body, not on the board; leave a cable path from the header

sources: BLOCK.md: 9 g, 22.5 x 12.1 x 23.4 mm, 250 mm lead
assumptions: the header on the board is a cable exit, not the servo body position
